item.revised_prompt: The gray quadcopter drone in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The solid white background in <Picture 1> is <Subject 2>. The target image shows <Subject 1> on <Subject 2> with its upper front nose section narrowed and more tightly rounded, while the camera window conforms to the reshaped leading edge. <Subject 1> is partially preserved; its four rotors, four diagonal arms, rear body section, and flat top-down illustration style remain unchanged, while only the upper front nose contour and the top boundary of the dark camera window are reshaped. <Subject 2> is fully preserved. At the top end of <Subject 1>, the forward-most tip is narrower and more smoothly rounded than before, tapering inward slightly from the main fuselage width into a compact, curved nose cone. The dark charcoal-gray rounded-rectangle camera window at the front of <Subject 1> follows this new contour, with its upper horizontal edge curving downward along the narrower rounded nose profile while keeping the circular black lens centered within it. The small triangular light-gray shoulder accents where the upper two arms meet the body adjust slightly outward to accommodate the narrower nose without altering the arms or rotors themselves.
